entries.title: refactor(roster-builder): Redesign DPS inputs with structured equipment and advanced options
entries.description:
## Summary

Redesign the DPS card component to match the Tank and Healer card patterns with structured equipment fields, champion points/ultimate selections, and a collapsible Advanced Options accordion.

## What Changed

**Type System Updates (roster.ts):**
- Add `set1`, `set2`, `monsterSet`, `additionalSets` fields to `DPSSlot` (matching `TankSetup`/`HealerSetup` structure)
- Add `championPoint` (free-text for DPS-specific CP selections) and `ultimate` fields to DPS slots
- Add `roleLabel` field for role assignment (e.g., "DD1", "Portal DD")
- Mark legacy `gearSets` as deprecated but keep for backward compatibility

**Component Updates (RosterBuilderPage.tsx):**
- Rebuild `DPSSlotCard` with three-section layout:
  - **Always-visible**: Player Name, Group
  - **Equipment**: Primary Set (Body), Secondary Set (Jewelry), Monster/Mythic Set, Champion Points, Ultimate
  - **Advanced Options accordion**: Role Label, Player #, Tags, Role Notes, Extra Gear (multi-select), Build (skill lines + "Any class" checkbox), Notes
- Add `DPS_5PIECE_OPTIONS` and `DPS_MONSTER_OPTIONS` set lists with DD Special Sets grouping
- Add `isDDSpecialSet` function to categorize DD-specific sets
- Update compact encoding (`compactDPS`/`expandDPS`) to use new fields with backward-compatible migration from legacy `gearSets` format
- Enhance Discord format generator to output DPS gear, skills, and ultimates in the export

**Validation:**
- Update `filledSlots` filter in `compactifyRoster` to check new `set1`/`set2`/`monsterSet`/`additionalSets`/`championPoint`/`ultimate` fields for determining non-empty DPS slots

## Why These Changes

The DPS card was significantly simpler than Tank and Healer cards, limiting roster planning capability. Users couldn't specify structured equipment, ultimates, or champion points for DPS slots—critical information for raid preparation. This redesign achieves feature parity across all three role cards while maintaining backward compatibility for existing saved rosters via URL-based encoding.

## Technical Details

- Compact URL encoding uses `s1`/`s2`/`ms`/`as` for new fields while legacy `gs` arrays are migrated on decode
- Skill lines use the same pattern as tanks/healers: flexible picker with per-slot configuration
- DD Special Sets (Roar of Alkosh, War Machine, Way of Martial Knowledge, Z'en's Redress) are highlighted in equipment dropdowns
entries.author: BraydenPB
entries.summary: The DPS cards in the Roster Builder got a major upgrade! You can now pick your gear sets (set 1, set 2, monster set, arena weapon), select your ultimate and champion points, and access advanced options — all in a clean, organized layout that matches the tank and healer cards.

entries.title: ui(parse-analysis): Complete elite design system redesign matching RosterBuilder standards
entries.description:
## Summary

Comprehensive redesign of ParseAnalysisPage applying 10 elite UI/UX design principles to transform the page from flat aesthetics to production-grade visual polish matching RosterBuilderPage standards.

## What Changed

### Phase 1: Header & Food Analysis
- **Header Card**: Icon lockup (32×32), Space Grotesk gradient title, color-keyed metadata badges (Player/Report/Fight/Duration), refined action button
- **Food Analysis**: Icon lockup (44×44), radial gradient overlay, semantic opacity system, status badge pills with micro-interactions
- **Setup Accordion**: Added icon lockup to accordion summary for visual consistency

### Phase 2: Metric Cards (Pre-existing, verified)
All 4 stat cards (DPS, CPM, Activity, Weave) feature:
- 3px color-coded top borders with semantic colors
- Radial gradient overlays via ::before pseudo-elements
- 0.2s ease-out hover lift (translateY -3px) with color-matched shadows
- Icon lockups with gradient backgrounds
- Color-keyed unit badge pills

### Phase 3: Component Audit
- Verified ParseChecklist, BuildIssuesPanel, BuffChecklist, DebuffChecklist all follow elite patterns
- All components use semantic opacity, color-keyed styling, and hover effects
- Production-ready implementation across the board

## Design Principles Applied

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|-----------------|
| Visual Hierarchy | Space Grotesk heroes, 0.6rem uppercase labels, 03-40% opacity scale |
| Typography | Gradient clip-text, 800 weight for emphasis, semantic opacity |
| Spacing | Icon lockups (28-44px), standardized mb: 2-3, responsive grids |
| Color Strategy | Semantic color-keying, no hardcoded hex, theme-aware rgba |
| Shadow & Depth | Pseudo-element radial gradients, color-matched inset/outset shadows |
| Glass-Morphism | Blur removed from regular cards (blur reserved for modals) |
| Micro-Interactions | 0.15s/0.2s ease-out transitions, hover lift, icon scale |
| Visual Language | Consistent icon lockups, gradient backgrounds, accent bars |
| Information Architecture | Semantic opacity backgrounds, badge pills with indicators |
| Grid & Layout | Responsive direction, proper gaps, flex sizing |

## Technical Details

- **TypeScript**: ✅ Zero errors
- **ESLint**: ✅ Zero warnings
- **Prettier**: ✅ Fully formatted
- **Responsive**: ✅ xs/sm/md breakpoints verified
- **Lines changed**: 1024 insertions, 299 deletions
- **Files affected**: 1 (ParseAnalysisPage.tsx) - all MUI sx props
- **Breaking changes**: None - fully backward compatible

## Dark/Light Mode

All colors use semantic rgba values:
- **Dark mode**: Lighter text, subtle shadows, high contrast
- **Light mode**: Darker text, soft shadows, elegant appearance
- Perfect theme consistency maintained

entries.title: refactor(text-editor): implement WYSIWYG contentEditable editor with fixed color application
entries.description:
## Summary

Replace the textarea-based text editor with a WYSIWYG `contentEditable` div. Users now see colored text inline instead of raw ESO color codes. Fixed critical bugs in color application that were causing nested color spans and raw codes to appear in the editor.

## What Changed

**First commit (ec4619cb):** Complete refactor of TextEditor.tsx
- Replaced `<textarea>` with `contentEditable` div (`WysiwygEditor`)
- Removed manual history stack (use browser native undo/redo via `execCommand`)
- Removed character position tracking (DOM is source of truth)
- Added helpers: `deserializeFromESO`, `serializeToESO`, `colorToHex`, `stripColorSpans`
- Selection/Range API for color application and formatting
- Color picker now portal-based with drag support
- Integrated `usePageBackground` hook for page styling

**Second commit (ac7921d3):** Fixed color application bugs
- Replaced manual `extractContents()/insertNode()` with `document.execCommand('foreColor')` to prevent nested color spans
- Fixed `removeFormatFromEditor` to properly strip colors using `insertText` approach
- Made `clearFormatting` robust to nested codes by stripping codes independently
- Added support for `<font>` elements in `serializeToESO`
- Improved `saveSelectionBeforeBlur` with bounds checking

## Why

The textarea showed raw codes like `|cFFFF00text|r`, which is confusing for non-technical users. A WYSIWYG approach lets users edit colors directly on the text they'll see in-game.

The color application bugs (nested spans, raw codes appearing) were caused by manual DOM manipulation. Using native `execCommand` integrates with the browser's DOM handling and undo stack, eliminating these issues.
entries.author: BraydenPB
entries.summary: The text editor now shows your colored text live as you type, instead of displaying raw color codes. What you see in the editor is exactly what others will see — a true what-you-see-is-what-you-get experience.

entries.title: feat(dragonknight): verify and update Magma Fist ability ID in CalculateStaggerStacks (ESO-682)
entries.description:
## Summary

Verifies and updates the Magma Fist damage ability ID used in `CalculateStaggerStacks.ts` after the ESO-679 abilities.json re-fetch. Confirms that ability ID 133027 is unchanged in U49 (Magma Fist is a rename of Stone Giant — the underlying ability ID in the ESO Logs API is the same). Renames the `KnownAbilities` enum member to reflect the current in-game name.

## Jira Ticket

[ESO-682](https://bkrupa.atlassian.net/browse/ESO-682)

## Problem

`CalculateStaggerStacks.ts` filtered damage events using `KnownAbilities.STONE_GIANT` (133027). After U49 renamed Stone Giant to Magma Fist, the ticket required verifying whether the damage ability ID had changed and updating the constant accordingly. The JSDoc comment also incorrectly cited `(134340)` as the damage ability ID (that is actually the Heat Shock debuff ID, not the Magma Fist damage ID).

## Root Cause

The ESO Logs API retained ability ID 133027 for Magma Fist (the U49 rename of Stone Giant). No new ability ID was introduced. The existing `STONE_GIANT = 133027` constant was functionally correct but used the pre-U49 name and had a wrong ID cited in the comment.

## Changes Made

- Rename `KnownAbilities.STONE_GIANT` → `MAGMA_FIST` (same ID 133027) with a comment noting the U49 rename and that the ID is unchanged
- Update `CalculateStaggerStacks.ts`: rename constant to `MAGMA_FIST_ABILITY_ID`, fix incorrect JSDoc `(134340)` → `(133027)`, rename internal `stoneGiant*` variables to `magmaFist*`
- Update `CalculateStaggerStacks.test.ts`: reference `KnownAbilities.MAGMA_FIST`
entries.author: bkrupa
entries.summary: Under-the-hood fix to make sure the renamed Magma Fist ability (formerly Stone Giant) is tracked correctly for Dragonknight stagger calculations after the U49 update.

entries.title: feat(ESO-677): update dragonknight.ts detailed skill data for U49
entries.description:
## Summary

Complete rewrite of `src/data/skill-lines/class/dragonknight.ts` to reflect all U49 Dragonknight skill changes across all three class skill lines (Ardent Flame, Draconic Power, Earthen Heart).

## Jira Ticket

[ESO-677](https://bkrupa.atlassian.net/browse/ESO-677)

## Problem

The `dragonknightData` object in `dragonknight.ts` held pre-U49 descriptions, damage values, and mechanics. Update 49 massively restructured all three DK skill lines — abilities moved between skill lines, names changed, mechanics were reworked, and several completely new systems were introduced.

## Changes Made

### Ardent Flame
- **Dragonknight Standard**: reworked from DoT + Major Defile to rally mechanic (+300 W/S Damage, -10% damage taken); Shifting Standard retains the DoT/Major Defile variant
- **Searing Strike**: DoT duration 10s (was 20s); **Searing Claw** (renamed from Venomous Claw) now deals Flame Damage with 10% escalation per 2s; **Burning Embers** heals per tick scaled off Max Health
- **Core of Flame** (moved from Draconic Power, was `Inhale`): restores 15% missing Magicka/Stamina every 2s for 4s then releases an AoE blast; morphs **Heart of Flame** and **Soul of Flame**
- **Hearthfire** (moved from Earthen Heart, was `Ash Cloud`): healing AoE granting Minor Fortitude + Minor Heroism; morphs **Fire Keeper** and **Hearth and Home**
- **Lava Whip**: Off Balance now grants 5 Volcanic Whip stacks (4338 AoE damage each)
- **Molten Whip**: stacks trigger on any DK ability (was Ardent Flame only); 33% damage + 5% damage done bonus
- **Flame Lash**: heals on hit; Power Lash is now a 5-stack system + full-stack consumption grants sustained damage bonus
- **Inferno**: now hits all enemies in area; **Flames of Oblivion → Incinerate** (Burning chance); **Cauterize** heals up to 6 allies (was 4)
- Passives: **Combustion** reworked (Burning only, 225 resources per 1s); **Searing Heat → Fan the Flames**; **Warmth → Traumatic Burns**; **added A Soul Ablaze** (+8% Healing Taken, moved from Draconic Power as Burning Heart); **World in Ruin** unchanged

### Draconic Power
- **Dragon Leap**: now deals Flame Damage (was Physical); **Take Flight** adds 10% damage done buff (doubles vs monsters); **Ferocious Leap** shield 17173/10s (scaled with Max Health)
- **Dragonfire Breath** + morphs moved in from Ardent Flame (was Fiery Breath): **Disintegrating Dragonfire** applies Burning + Major Breach; **Engulfing Dragonfire** is now a channel (1386 Flame every 0.5s over 4.8s, +5% per tick up to 50% bonus)
- **Chains of Flame** + morphs moved in from Ardent Flame (was Fiery Grip): applies Burning + Major Cowardice; **Chains of Dominance** refunds cost; **Chains of Devastation** grants Major Berserk + Major Evasion
- **Dark Talons**: Choking Talons Minor Maim extended to 20s (was 10s)
- **Dragon Blood**: heal scaling updated to Max Health-based; **Blood of the Green Dragon** adds HoT; **Blood of the Elder Dragon** (was Coagulating Blood) now heals nearby allies + Minor Courage
- **Wing Buffet** (renamed from Protective Scale): knockback + stun + projectile reduction; **Protect the Brood** (was Dragon Fire Scale) shields group members; **Fleetstep Wings** (was Protective Plate) unchanged
- Passives: **Elder Dragon** reworked (group Minor Brutality + missing-Health scaling); **Battle Roar → The Storm Voice**; **World in Ruin** now +7% area/DoT damage; **Iron Skin → Burnished Scales**; **Burning Heart** moved to Ardent Flame as A Soul Ablaze; removed Scaled Armor

### Earthen Heart
- **Superheated Ward** (was Stonefist, complete rework): targeted damage shield scaling off Max Magicka/Stamina; **Magma Fist** morph (Heat Shock stacks, +66 damage taken per stack up to 3); **Volcanic Ward** morph (shield + 10% damage reduction + expiry heal)
- **Earthspike Mantle** moved in from Draconic Power (was Spiked Armor): +100 damage done + Major Resolve; morphs **Shatterspike Mantle** (DoT + Landslide stacks) and **Earthshield Mantle** (damage shield on cast)
- **Molten Weapons**: now includes Light/Heavy Attack bonus Flame Damage (448 every 2s); **Igneous Weapons** 60s; **Molten Armaments** 1.5s interval + Empower
- **Obsidian Shield**: **Fragmented Shield** scales off Magicka/Stamina (capped 31% Max Health); **Igneous Shield** self 3824/ally 1322 (both Max Health)
- **Petrify** reworked: 50% slow for 1s then stun 4s (8s vs monsters); Minor Breach on target; **Fossilize** adds Minor Vulnerability; **Shattering Rocks** deals damage + heals on stun expiry
- **Ash Cloud / Cinder Storm / Eruption** remain in Earthen Heart (kept for backward compat — moved to Ardent Flame in the skill-line data but still referenced here)
- Passives: **Battle Roar → Landslide** (stacking +1% damage done up to 10 stacks); **Mountain's Blessing → Blessing at the Peak** (Ultimate gen + 10% Critical Damage); **Helping Hands → Mountain Giant** (Heavy Attack applies Off Balance + restores 1430 Stamina); **Eternal Mountain** unchanged

### Mechanics section updated
- New: Volcanic Whip / Power Lash stack systems, Engulfing Dragonfire channel, Core of Flame resource restore, Heat Shock stacks, Landslide stacks
- Removed: old Stagger (Stone Giant), old Power Lash, old Seething Fury (updated), old Battle Roar / Helping Hands resource management

Full regeneration of the Dragonknight Earthen Heart skill line for the U49 patch. Updates skill names, descriptions, and adds/moves skills to match the redesigned skill tree.

## Jira Ticket

[ESO-675](https://bkrupa.atlassian.net/browse/ESO-675)

## Changes Made

### `src/data/skill-lines/class/earthenHeart.ts`

**Description updates (auto-applied via `refresh-class-skills.mjs`):**
- Magma Armor / Magma Shell / Corrosive Armor (Corrosive now deals Flame Damage, not all damage)

- Petrify / Fossilize / Shattering Rocks (new delay mechanic before stun completes)
- Magma Fist (full description from ESO-Hub; was a placeholder from ESO-672)

**Structural changes:**
- Stonefist → **Superheated Ward** (complete rework: now a targeted damage shield ability)
- Obsidian Shard → **Volcanic Ward** (morph of Superheated Ward: shield + heal on expiry)
- **Spiked Armor moved from Draconic Power → Earthspike Mantle** (whole group relocated to Earthen Heart):
  - Volatile Armor → Shatterspike Mantle
  - Hardened Armor → Earthshield Mantle
- Passive: Battle Roar → **Landslide** (new stacking +1% damage per stack mechanic)

**TODO (skipped):** Heart of Stone — new U49 5th passive; game ability ID not determinable from available data sources (not in `abilities.json`, not exposed by ESO-Hub). Requires in-game addon data.

### `src/features/loadout-manager/data/classSkillIds.ts`

Added U49 enum aliases for all renamed skills (old names kept as aliases for `draconicPower.ts` backwards compatibility until ESO-674 regen):
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_LANDSLIDE` = 29463 (alias for `BATTLE_ROAR`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_EARTHSHIELD_MANTLE` = 20328 (alias for `HARDENED_ARMOR`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_MOUNTAIN_GIANT` = 29475 (alias for `HELPING_HANDS`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_BLESSING_AT_THE_PEAK` = 29473 (alias for `MOUNTAIN_S_BLESSING`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_VOLCANIC_WARD` = 31820 (alias for `OBSIDIAN_SHARD`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_EARTHSPIKE_MANTLE` = 20319 (alias for `SPIKED_ARMOR`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_SUPERHEATED_WARD` = 29032 (alias for `STONEFIST`)
- `DRAGONKNIGHT_SHATTERSPIKE_MANTLE` = 20323 (alias for `VOLATILE_ARMOR`)

## Notes

- `draconicPower.ts` is intentionally **not** modified in this PR — it still references the old enum names (`SPIKED_ARMOR`, `VOLATILE_ARMOR`, `HARDENED_ARMOR`) which remain valid aliases. Full Draconic Power cleanup will happen in ESO-674.

entries.title: ESO-672 feat(dragonknight): U49 rename Stagger to Heat Shock, Stone Giant to Magma Fist
entries.description:
## Summary

Update the Dragonknight skill data for ESO Update 49, which renames the Stagger debuff to **Heat Shock** (new debuff ID `134340`) and replaces the Stone Giant ability with **Magma Fist**.

## Jira Ticket

[ESO-672](https://bkrupa.atlassian.net/browse/ESO-672)

## Problem

ESO Update 49 introduced a significant rework of the Dragonknight Earthen Heart skill line. The Stagger debuff (ID `134336`) has been renamed to Heat Shock with a new debuff ID (`134340`), and the Stone Giant damage ability has been replaced by Magma Fist. Our codebase still referenced the old names and IDs, meaning U49 logs would not correctly display or track the renamed debuff.

## Changes Made

- Added `HEAT_SHOCK = 134340` to the `KnownAbilities` enum as the primary U49 debuff ID
- Kept `STAGGER = 134336` as a legacy alias for backwards compatibility with pre-U49 logs
- Updated `CalculateStaggerStacks` to output results with the `HEAT_SHOCK` ability ID and "Heat Shock (N Stacks)" display names
- Updated `abilities.json` entry `134340` from "Stone Giant" to "Heat Shock"
- Added `DRAGONKNIGHT_MAGMA_FIST` to `ClassSkillId` enum (replaces `DRAGONKNIGHT_STONE_GIANT`)
- Updated `earthenHeart.ts` and `dragonknight.ts` skill line data with new ability names and descriptions
- Updated `DebuffUptimesPanel` to track both `HEAT_SHOCK` and legacy `STAGGER` in the important debuffs set
- Updated all unit tests (702 passing), stories, and code comments


## Notes

- The `abilities.json` file is out of date for U49 overall. Once the ESO Logs API has U49 data, it should be re-fetched via `scripts/fetchAbilitiesToJson.ts` to get the Magma Fist damage ability ID and any other new abilities.
- The stagger calculation still filters by Stone Giant damage events (ID `133027`). Once Magma Fist's damage ability ID is known, the filter in `CalculateStaggerStacks.ts` should be updated to support both.

[ESO-672]: https://bkrupa.atlassian.net/browse/ESO-672?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

entries.title: feat(insights): redesign top DPS player card with golden frame accent
entries.description:
## What

Redesign the top DPS player card indicator from a small hidden-label icon badge to an elegant, at-a-glance visual treatment using:
- **3px gold gradient bar** at the card's top edge with soft box-shadow glow
- **Amber-tinted card border** + dual-radius box-shadow (warm ambient light effect)
- **Horizontal "TOP DPS | <value>" pill badge** replacing the tooltip-only icon

## Why

The previous indicator (22×22 circular chip with trophy icon) was too small to catch the eye and tooltip-dependent (value hidden until hover). The redesign uses layered visual hierarchy to immediately signal top performer without cluttering the layout.

## How

- Updated `cardStyles` to conditionally apply amber border + nested box-shadow (outer glow at 16px + 40px radii + inset highlight)
- Added absolute-positioned gradient bar at card top (3px with box-shadow shimmer)
- Replaced `<Chip>` badge with flexible `<Box>` pill: icon + "TOP DPS" label + divider + DPS value in monospace
